lines.text: Taurus, loyalty past the expiry date is just habit with good manners.
lines.caption: check the date

lines.text: Taurus, you stayed because it was familiar, not because it was good.
lines.caption: familiar is not good

lines.text: Taurus, you would rather keep a slow ache than risk a quick change.
lines.caption: the slow ache

lines.text: Taurus, they had years to change. You can stop waiting now.
lines.caption: stop waiting

lines.text: Taurus, you don't need to test someone for a year before you trust them.
lines.caption: a year is a lot

lines.text: Taurus, the person who cooks for you is saying more than they say out loud.
lines.caption: they said it with food

lines.text: Taurus, you are not stubborn. You are scared of losing what you have.
lines.caption: it's fear actually

lines.text: Taurus, the old relationship is a warm house with no roof.
lines.caption: no roof

lines.text: Taurus, letting someone new in will not burn down your life.
lines.caption: open the door

lines.text: Taurus, love is not a thing you own. It is a thing you tend.
lines.caption: tend it

lines.text: Taurus, being right is cold company on a Friday night.
lines.caption: cold company

lines.text: Taurus, they can't read the silence you think is so obvious.
lines.caption: they can't hear silence

lines.text: Taurus, you give them gifts so you never have to give them the words.
lines.caption: the words, please

lines.text: Taurus, you can forgive them and still not go back.
lines.caption: forgive not return

lines.text: Taurus, if it took them five years to choose you, that is an answer.
lines.caption: that is an answer

lines.text: Taurus, holding on tighter never once made anyone stay.
lines.caption: tighter never worked

lines.text: Taurus, you made them wait so long they mistook it for a no.
lines.caption: they heard a no

lines.text: Taurus, you keep watering a plant that died last spring.
lines.caption: it died in april

lines.text: Taurus, your heart is not a fixed asset. Let it move.
lines.caption: not a fixed asset

lines.text: Taurus, a slow yes is still a yes. Say it out loud.
lines.caption: say yes

lines.text: Taurus, you keep their hoodie like it means they will come back.
lines.caption: return the hoodie

lines.text: Taurus, stay for the person, not for the routine you built around them.
lines.caption: not for the routine

lines.text: Taurus, if it only works when nothing changes, it doesn't work.
lines.caption: it doesn't work

lines.text: Taurus, being steady is a gift. Being stuck is a choice.
lines.caption: steady not stuck

lines.text: Taurus, safe and boring are not the same. You know which one this is.
lines.caption: you know which

lines.text: Taurus, a good dinner can't fix a bad week. A real talk can.
lines.caption: talk over dinner

lines.text: Taurus, you refuse to argue, then hold it for six months.
lines.caption: six months later

lines.text: Taurus, wanting them more when someone else looks is not love. It is ownership.
lines.caption: mine is not a feeling

lines.text: Taurus, love that never surprises you will slowly put you to sleep.
lines.caption: surprise them

lines.text: Taurus, the touch you hold back is the thing they are missing most.
lines.caption: reach over

lines.text: Taurus, the couch will still be there after you start.
lines.caption: the couch can wait

lines.text: Taurus, you are not lazy. You just hate starting things that might fail.
lines.caption: not lazy just scared

lines.text: Taurus, saving money is wise. Hiding from life with it is not.
lines.caption: spend a little

lines.text: Taurus, change is slow for you. Slow is still moving.
lines.caption: slow still counts

lines.text: Taurus, the routine that saved you can also trap you.
lines.caption: check the routine

lines.text: Taurus, comfort is a good place to rest and a bad place to live.
lines.caption: rest not live

lines.text: Taurus, buying the nice thing will not fix the bad day.
lines.caption: put the cart down

lines.text: Taurus, you have been about to start for three years now.
lines.caption: about to start

lines.text: Taurus, being stubborn is only strength when you point it the right way.
lines.caption: aim it

lines.text: Taurus, try one new thing this month. The old ones will wait.
lines.caption: one new thing

lines.text: Taurus, security is something you build, not something you hoard.
lines.caption: build not hoard

lines.text: Taurus, the snack is not the problem. The boredom under it is.
lines.caption: it's not the snack

lines.text: Taurus, your pace is fine. Stop letting fast people shame it.
lines.caption: your pace is fine

lines.text: Taurus, the job you hate pays the bills and costs the dream.
lines.caption: count the cost

lines.text: Taurus, you hold onto old opinions like old sweaters. Some don't fit.
lines.caption: some don't fit

lines.text: Taurus, rest is your talent. Use it to recover, not to hide.
lines.caption: recover not hide

lines.text: Taurus, a little risk now is cheaper than a lot of regret later.
lines.caption: cheaper than regret

lines.text: Taurus, you keep buying comfort for a life you have not chosen yet.
lines.caption: choose it first

lines.text: Taurus, nothing grows in soil that never gets turned over.
lines.caption: turn the soil

lines.text: Taurus, the plan is solid. Now you have to take the first step.
lines.caption: first step

lines.text: Taurus, being dependable for everyone left nothing for you.
lines.caption: save some for you

lines.text: Taurus, the habit you start slowly is the one you never drop.
lines.caption: slow sticks

lines.text: Taurus, the pattern breaks when you try the thing you swore you wouldn't.
lines.caption: you swore though

lines.text: Taurus, you can change your mind and still be the same person.
lines.caption: still you

lines.text: Taurus, you are not waiting for the right time. You are waiting for no risk.
lines.caption: no risk doesn't exist

lines.text: Taurus, you carry everyone's weight like it proves something. It doesn't.
lines.caption: it proves nothing

lines.text: Taurus, the safe choice keeps you safe and also keeps you small.
lines.caption: safe and small

lines.text: Taurus, peace is good. Numb is not peace.
lines.caption: numb is not peace

lines.text: Taurus, the earth moves slowly too, and it never once stops.
lines.caption: slow but never stopped

lines.text: Taurus, enjoy what you have without being afraid to lose it.
lines.caption: enjoy it
